title: The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip: Roaring 20th
original_title: The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip: Roaring 20th
overview: In this special event series, the Housewives make their way through some of the most memorable locations in the franchise’s history – from Orange County, where it all began, to Beverly Hills, Atlanta, Miami, and New York City. Starting where it all began in Orange County and culminating in an epic East Coast grand finale, each stop will feature appearances by fan favorites from different cities to pay tribute to the past, embrace the present, and look toward the many miles still ahead. Along the way, viewers can expect nostalgic reunions, heartfelt revelations, effortless humor, and the larger-than-life dynamics that only Housewives can deliver.
